prompt: A lean human assassin in close-fitting charcoal-grey leathers and a black hood drives a thin curved dagger into the back of a city sentry in a rigid side profile facing east. The sentry buckles, eyes wide, a single shallow cut at his neck spreading a sickly venom-green glow that races through his veins as the small wound proves instantly lethal. The only source of light is the green poison-glow of the wound and a low torch. The background is a narrow cobblestone alley between dark stone walls at night.

A slender human assassin in black hooded leathers, his lower body and one arm dissolving into swirling shadow so he cannot be pinned down, slips between two confused armored city guards who both lunge and grab at empty smoke where he just was. The assassin holds a thin venom-green dagger low. Two guards, both fully visible head to knee, the same size, reaching from opposite sides. The only source of light is a flickering wall torch. The background is a moonlit stone courtyard at night.

Close-up bust of a human assassin in a black hood and charcoal-grey leather collar, only the lower half of his face visible with a cold grin, the rest of him dissolving into deep shadow. He raises a thin curved dagger whose edge drips a glistening sickly venom-green droplet. The only source of light is a faint cold blue moonlight catching the blade and his cheekbone. The background is a pitch-black night sky with the silhouette of stone rooftops.

A lithe human assassin in close-fitting black leathers and a streaming dark cloak vaults across a gap between two stone rooftops in a full side profile, mid-leap and weightless, his trailing edge breaking apart into wisps of black smoke so he seems impossible to catch. A thin dagger with a venom-green edge is clenched in one hand. The only source of light is a pale full moon behind him. The background is a city of dark pointed rooftops at night.

A small lithe human assassin in black leathers drives a thin venom-green dagger up into the gut of a towering armored knight twice his size, who is fully visible head to foot and topples backward, his great sword slipping from his grip, sickly green poison spreading from the tiny wound through his whole body proving even a scratch is instantly lethal. Two figures, both fully visible, the assassin small and the knight huge. The only source of light is the green poison-glow. The background is a torch-lit castle hall at night.

A human assassin in a black hood and charcoal leathers lunges out of deep darkness straight toward the viewer, one arm thrusting a thin venom-green dagger at the camera, his face a cold grin half-lost in shadow, his shoulders trailing into wisps of black smoke. The only source of light is the sickly green glow of the poisoned blade lighting his face from below. The background is pitch-black with faint cold blue moonlight at the edges.
